visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair wearing a white and red tank top squats on a marble staircase, leaning forward to greet a white French Bulldog at the bottom. She has a happy expression, mouth open as if talking. The lighting is bright indoor natural light. (2) The woman holds the dog's front paw, lifting it up to her nose and sniffing it with a playful, affectionate look. The dog remains calm. The setting is still the indoor stairs with white walls and a wooden banister. (3) Indoors, the woman sits on a brown leather couch, hugging the white French Bulldog close to her chest. She smiles broadly, looking at the camera. The dog has its tongue out, appearing relaxed. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (4) A series of quick cuts shows the woman holding the dog in various poses. One scene shows the dog lying on a bed next to a person's legs, and another shows the dog's face in a close-up while it licks its lips. A red polka-dot border appears. (5) The woman sits on green grass in a park with trees and a lake in the background. She holds a tablet and gestures with her right hand while speaking to the camera. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (6) Close-up shots of the French Bulldog being fed small treats by hand and drinking water from a stainless steel bowl on the floor. The background shows wooden furniture and marble tiles. (7) In a car interior, the woman holds the dog while looking out the window. Then, a close-up of the dog's face as it panting with its tongue out. Soft natural light comes through the car windows. (8) Back in the park, the woman walks the dog on a red leash across a dirt path. She stops to give the dog water from a pink bowl. The camera follows their movement from a medium shot. (9) The woman stands in the park again, speaking directly to the camera while holding the tablet. She uses various hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background features lush green foliage and a modern building. (10) A close-up of the dog's face as a hand pets its head. The dog blinks and looks comfortable. Text overlays with icons appear on the screen, detailing medical care steps. (11) The woman stands on an urban sidewalk with high-rise buildings in the distance. She holds the dog and talks to the camera, wearing the same white and red tank top. The scene is brightly lit by afternoon sun. (12) The final scene shows a white screen with the logos of the Ministry of Agriculture and TAIWAN SPCA. Text in Traditional Chinese and English is displayed, concluding the video's message.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: POV: 狗奴才才有的行為. (2) [Variety]: 1 捏狗狗的肉肉. [Subtitle]: 你有沒有想我!? (3) [Variety]: (好癢～好癢). [Subtitle]: 你說一下你現在什麼心情. (4) [Variety]: 2 狂吸狗狗腳掌味道. (5) [Variety]: (聞～). (6) [Variety]: 3 一回家就要跟狗狗狂講話. [Subtitle]: 你怎樣. 你好肥喔. (7) [Variety]: (好舒服～). (8) [Variety]: (讓我們冷靜一點) 好可愛. [Subtitle]: 你幹嘛打哈欠. 我們家阿肥已經養11年了. (9) [Subtitle]: 這個籠子買的第一天晚上. 我爸超級捨不得. 所以那一天晚上. 就直接抱阿肥上去一起睡覺. 大家知道嗎? 其實在台灣有非常多的飼主. (10) [Subtitle]: 他們在養寵物的時候. 都會長期把他們關在籠子裡面. 或者是以為他們用鏈條給綁住. 這樣長期下來其實對於寵物真的是非常的不舒服. (11) [Variety]: (好吃!!). [Subtitle]: 然後對他們也不友善. 甚至是因爲太短的關係. 他們就長期沒有辦法平躺. 或是有一個良好的姿勢. (12) [Subtitle]: 有些人會擔心狗狗會攻擊人. 或是有吠叫的行為. 或是貓咪會抓家具等等的原因. 會把他們給關起來. 但其實這樣反而是一個反效果. (13) [Slogan]: 包含外出散步和玩遊戲. 提供給寵物適當的環境. [Subtitle]: 不當的飼養反而會造成寵物行為上面跟精神上面有非常多的負面影響. 提供給寵物適當的環境. 符合習性的日常. (14) [Slogan]: 能降低吠叫狀況. [Subtitle]: 才可以有效的釋放壓力喔. 對寵物的身心靈也才是最好的. (15) [Subtitle]: 如果你長期把寵物關在籠子裡面. 或者是綁在鏈子裡面. 是已經違反動物保護法. 所以呢這樣是觸法的喔. (16) [Subtitle]: 6年前阿肥因爲子宮蓄膿開刀. 後來研究才知道其實狗狗絕育是非常重要的. 而且它可以避掉很多生殖系統相關的疾病. (17) [Slogan]: 貓咪也是!. [Subtitle]: 公母都是. 無論是預防性的保護照顧. 或者是狂犬病疫苗. (18) [Slogan]: 定期預防針、體內外除蟲. 心絲蟲預防等. [Subtitle]: 甚至絕育等等之類的. 對於飼主們來說呢都是必要知道的常識. 可以降低動物生病跟痛苦. (19) [Slogan]: 法規規範飼主應為寵物完成. [Subtitle]: 食物上面也會建議呢. 給予一些營養充分的飼料和鮮食. 可以避免狗狗吃一些人類的剩菜. 也是超級關鍵的喔. (20) [Slogan]: 領養不棄養. [Subtitle]: 總而言之呢. 妥善照顧你們家的毛小孩是飼主的責任. 養他就要負責他一輩子喔. 基本的日常照顧和陪伴都超級重要. (21) [Subtitle]: 希望大家都能夠領養不棄養. 讓你的狗狗活在一個充滿愛跟成長的環境. 如果呢你已經有可愛的毛小孩的話. 就一定要照顧他一輩子喔. 阿肥你有幸福嗎? (22) [Variety]: (好幸福～). [Logo]: 農業部. TAIWAN SPCA. 廣告.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, using a playful and affectionate tone directed at a pet. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a strong rhythmic beat and bright acoustic guitar enters immediately. (2) As the visuals transition to sniffing the paw, a short, stylized sniffing SFX (whoosh) is heard. The woman's voice continues with a comedic, high-arousal inflection, accompanied by the steady, cheerful background music that maintains a constant BPM of around 120. (3) The female voice shifts to a slightly more structured but still friendly narrative tone. The background music continues without interruption, providing a consistent energetic bed. Subtle incidental sounds of the dog's collar clicking can be heard in the mix. (4) A transition SFX (a soft 'pop' or bubble sound) marks the shift to the educational segment. The woman's speech rate remains moderate and clear, enunciating terms about pet care laws and medical procedures with professional clarity. (5) The ambient noise floor shifts slightly to an outdoor park setting with very faint wind and distant environmental hum. The background music swells slightly in volume during transitions between spoken sentences, maintaining the positive valence of the track. (6) Sound effects of the dog lapping water and crunching on a treat are layered into the audio. These incidental noises are clear but secondary to the main narration, which remains the dominant signal with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (7) The narration becomes more authoritative yet remains warm as it discusses legal requirements. The pitch variability is moderate, using falling intonations at the end of key points for emphasis. The BGM rhythm remains synchronized with the overall editing pace. (8) In the final segment, the woman's voice returns to a more personal, high-arousal emotional tone, urging viewers to "adopt, don't abandon." The music reaches a concluding cadence with a final harmonic resolution. (9) The audio ends with a short, bright digital jingle or stinger SFX as the brand logos appear on screen. This is followed by a second of studio silence, providing a clean technical exit to the master audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Playful Intro -> Educational Guidelines -> Legal Compliance -> Emotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a public service announcement (PSA) to educate pet owners on responsible care and legal requirements. It begins with relatable, humorous 'dog slave' behaviors to hook the audience, then transitions into informative tips about not caging pets, regular health check-ups, and the importance of neutering, concluding with an emotional appeal to adopt rather than abandon.
